name: RoTLD .ro zone file
access_method: Request a zone-file agreement directly from RoTLD/ICI
coverage: Potentially the most complete list of actively delegated .ro names
notes: ccTLD zone access is not covered by ICANN CZDS; request terms directly from the registry. Does not necessarily contain registered but inactive names.

name: RoTLD WHOIS
coverage: Registration status for a known .ro domain
notes: Not a discovery feed. Never bypass CAPTCHA or bulk-query without written permission.

name: Common Crawl Domain Web Graph May-July 2026
coverage: Registrable domains crawled by or linked from Common Crawl
notes: Primary phase-one bulk source; domain vertices are already aggregated with the Public Suffix List.

name: Common Crawl URL Index
coverage: URLs captured by Common Crawl, including paths and historical captures
notes: Use the columnar index for bulk TLD extraction; do not overload the CDX API.

name: Common Crawl Host Web Graph
coverage: Hosts and subdomains crawled by or referenced from the web
notes: Useful after apex-domain discovery to build the hostname graph.

name: Public Certificate Transparency logs
coverage: DNS names appearing in publicly trusted TLS certificates
notes: Prefer incremental log ingestion over bulk wildcard queries to third-party search services.

name: Living data set: almost all web domains
coverage: Hundreds of millions of public-suffix domains observed in CT logs
license: No license stated on project page (checked 2026-08-13)
notes: Very high-value CT-derived bulk source. The complete DNS release preserves this candidate provenance but does not claim to relicense the upstream compilation.

name: OpenINTEL ccTLD names from CT logs
access_method: Closed dataset; access may be requested
coverage: ccTLD apex names learned from Certificate Transparency plus daily DNS measurements
license: OpenINTEL terms; commercial licensing by request
notes: Potentially supplies both names and historical DNS observations.

name: Tranco Top 1 Million
coverage: Research-oriented aggregation of popular domains
notes: Good ranking signal, limited discovery coverage; retain list identity/date for reproducibility.

name: Majestic Million
coverage: One million domains ranked by backlink/referring subnet signals
notes: Current list is downloadable; attribution to Majestic is required.

name: Cloudflare Radar Domain Rankings
coverage: Top 100 ordered and top-million popularity buckets derived from 1.1.1.1 DNS
notes: Ranking source rather than a comprehensive domain list.

name: Chrome UX Report origin summary
coverage: Origins with enough opted-in Chrome user measurements
notes: The materialized origin_summary table is updated monthly.

name: Cisco Umbrella Top 1 Million
coverage: Popular queried names; includes subdomains and infrastructure names
notes: Useful discovery/ranking input, but redistribution terms must be clarified.

name: Rapid7 Project Sonar Forward DNS
access_method: API key and large bulk downloads
coverage: A, AAAA, CNAME, TXT and historical DNS names known to Rapid7
notes: Files can be hundreds of gigabytes; process remotely or stream-filter .ro names.

name: Censys certificate repository
access_method: Licensed full snapshot plus daily deltas
coverage: Large normalized certificate repository and CT metadata
notes: Use only if a license explicitly permits the intended processing/export.

name: urlscan.io public scans
access_method: Search API and datasets subject to rate/usage terms
coverage: Domains and URLs submitted for public web scans
notes: Good incremental discovery source; may contain sensitive submitted URLs, so retain only normalized domains.

name: Internet Archive Wayback CDX
access_method: CDX API/index subject to rate and archive terms
coverage: Historical URLs captured by the Internet Archive
license: Internet Archive terms and original-content rights
notes: Useful for historical discovery after seed acquisition; do not bulk-hammer public endpoints.

name: GitHub public code and repository metadata
coverage: Domains embedded in public source, configuration and documentation
notes: Use as discovery evidence, not as permission to republish source contents.

name: Overture Maps Places
coverage: Places and businesses, some with website fields
license: Overture data license and per-source attribution
notes: Filter Romanian places and extract website hostnames while retaining source attribution.

name: OpenStreetMap
access_method: Planet/regional extracts or Overpass for scoped queries
coverage: Mapped Romanian entities with website/contact:website tags
notes: For bulk use prefer regional extracts rather than broad Overpass queries.

name: Wikidata
access_method: Dumps or SPARQL for scoped queries
coverage: Official websites for Romanian organizations, institutions and notable entities
notes: Small but high-confidence source for entity-domain associations.

name: data.gov.ro datasets
coverage: Romanian public institutions and sector datasets that may expose official websites
notes: Evaluate each dataset's license before enabling public export.

name: Public Suffix List
coverage: Registrable-boundary rules including .ro second-level suffixes
notes: Does not discover domains; it prevents incorrect apex-domain normalization.

name: web3metatrade/cui-ro-dataset websites
coverage: Websites already associated with active Romanian companies
notes: High-value seed source; preserve underlying source family in later evidence imports.

name: Scrape The World legacy website list
access_method: Purchased file with direct publication permission
coverage: Legacy website candidates associated with Romanian CUIs
license: Direct permission from Scrape The World CEO held by maintainer
notes: Import all syntactically valid .ro domains into discovery; company attribution remains a separate confidence decision.

name: Search engine result APIs
coverage: Indexed pages matching Romanian/domain/company queries
notes: Use for targeted gap filling, never scrape result pages in violation of service terms.

name: Commercial passive DNS providers
coverage: Historical domain, subdomain and DNS observations
notes: Examples include SecurityTrails, DomainTools, WhoisXML API and DNSDB. Keep vendor datasets separate unless redistribution is licensed.

name: Public abuse and phishing feeds
coverage: Malicious or suspicious URLs that can reveal otherwise obscure .ro domains
notes: Evaluate URLhaus, PhishTank, OpenPhish and national CERT feeds individually; publish only normalized domains where terms permit.

name: Common Crawl Domain Web Graph May-July 2025
coverage: Historical registrable domains crawled by or linked from Common Crawl
notes: Historical recovery snapshot spaced one year before the current graph.

name: Common Crawl Domain Web Graph May-July 2024
coverage: Historical registrable domains crawled by or linked from Common Crawl
notes: Historical recovery snapshot spaced two years before the current graph.

name: Common Crawl Domain Web Graph May-November 2023
coverage: Historical registrable domains crawled by or linked from Common Crawl
notes: Historical recovery snapshot for domains no longer present in recent web graphs.
